title: Diagnose and correct the effective Git-attribute refusal for managed task files
outcome: Task materialization diagnoses the actual effective attribute value and applies the intended managed policy without blocking valid publication or weakening unsafe-attribute refusals.
acceptance: The refusal reports the path, attribute, actual value and expected safe values with a concrete remedy, so CI no longer hides the deciding value
The effective policy accepts text=set with eol=lf and diagnoses the actual unsupported value found by the failing materialize scenarios, without weakening unsafe filter, encoding or override refusals
The two failing task_sync_materialize_cli scenarios pass on the corrected tree
